mentions.name: Calmsea
mentions.description: A financial forecasting and retirement planning tool that lets users drill down on individual assets, tweak parameters, and view their financial outlook from different angles.
mentions.problem: Existing financial calculators were either too simple, not focused on what was needed, or existed mainly to upsell users to financial planners or buyers agents.

https://calmsea.io

Financial Forecasting/Retirement Tool but you can drill down on individual assets and tweak params and see it from different angles.
